title: Four-stage active lowpass chain
application: Four cascaded buffered RC filters, ideal gain 16, 100k load, DC input 0.01V
netlist:
VINPUT vin 0 DC 0.01 AC 1
VP vp 0 DC 15
VN vn 0 DC -15
RS1 vin lp1 10k
CS1 lp1 0 10n
XAMP1 lp1 fb1 vp vn stage1 IDEALOPAMP
RFB1 stage1 fb1 10k
RGND1 fb1 0 10k
RS2 stage1 lp2 10k
CS2 lp2 0 10n
XAMP2 lp2 fb2 vp vn stage2 IDEALOPAMP
RFB2 stage2 fb2 10k
RGND2 fb2 0 10k
RS3 stage2 lp3 10k
CS3 lp3 0 10n
XAMP3 lp3 fb3 vp vn stage3 IDEALOPAMP
RFB3 stage3 fb3 10k
RGND3 fb3 0 10k
RS4 stage3 lp4 10k
CS4 lp4 0 10n
XAMP4 lp4 fb4 vp vn out IDEALOPAMP
RFB4 out fb4 10k
RGND4 fb4 0 10k
RLOAD out 0 100k
.end
